text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The kingdom of swords and spells,
Umanest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In this world, the title of fleetest goes not
to the dire wolves, nor to
the wyverns.

text_block_list.name: Orc
text_block_list.text:
Bugro, bugrbrgrbgrrr, bugogogo?!

(Bullcrap! How can they be catching up
with us?!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaa! Stop it right there, you thievin' orc!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We've caught up with it, El. It's time to
attack!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You betcha, Grass! Hiyaaaah! CONDOR
FISTS OF FURYYY!
A few hours earlier...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Here they are! The VR Umalators!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
VR... Umalators? Is that what these three
things are, Director? They
look like metal
caskets.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain. The VR Umalator is a
racing simulator
developed for the use of
Tracen Academy students.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Turf or dirt, firm or wet—the virtual track
can emulate all kinds of
racecourse
conditions.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... A customizable track certainly
would be convenient.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, a simulator though, huh? So
much for being my personal
napping pod.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
But wait! There's more—a feature that lets
you play affiliated online
games in VR,
using your own physical stats!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With this add-on, we can send our beloved
Umamusume to magical
kingdoms, sci-fi
galaxies, cyberpunk cities... Anywhere you
can dream
of!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
D-Director... You know how much I voiced
my concerns over that
function...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yet, you decided to install it regardless of
the trouble it might cause.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! My aim is to further expand the
greatness of my
Umamusume! Even if I
have to spend all my pocket money in the

process!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oooh, so you can run and play games, then? These machines can do everything!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It looks like someone's already trying
one. Might I ask who?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
President Symboli Rudolf is giving it a test
run on behalf of the
academy. We can't
have our students utilizing faulty
equipment.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's our trusty president! Hey, Director. I
also wanna—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that a warning signal?

text_block_list.name: Machine Voice
text_block_list.text:
Emergency, emergency. An anomaly has
been detected in device 01.

text_block_list.name: Machine Voice
text_block_list.text:
Connecting devices 02 and 03 to the
session may enable remote
repairs. If the
issue persists, please perform a factory
reset.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A factory reset?! We can't!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We'd have to reconfigure everything from
scratch... What could be
happening in
device 01?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf?
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It seems like the president is running like
normal though...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, it sounds like the virtual world
needs saving! Backup!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I know! Since everyone here's twiddlin' their thumbs, let me get in and fix it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm the sturdiest! Stubbornest! The
absolute strongeeest! A little tech
trouble
doesn't scare me!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'm going too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If there's a problem with the machine, you
might not be able to
handle it by yourself.
I'll help you out, if need be.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a fabulous duo! Seeing as you're
close friends, I'm sure you'll do
a fine job!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Try not to get yourselves hurt. Now, off
you go!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I guess this is the start button. One
push, and we should enter
runnin' mode...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, this isn't running mode? What
happened to connecting to
the same
session?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?! Where are we, Grass? What's this
place? And what am I
wearin'?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It... looks like we're in some kind of fantasy
game world. Did a
different mode get
activated?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fantasy... Then this get-up... I must be
some kind of monk brawler.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And it looks like I'm a cleric. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I can even see my stats. I suppose that
confirms the fantasy game
theory.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But why? We were meant to enter running
mode and link with device
01...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be for a reason! Maybe we need
to fix whatever problem's
unfoldin' in this
world first!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, forgive me if I'm wrong, but I'm getting
the impression you just
want to go
exploring.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Though you have a point. If the device
brought us here, the root of
the error
might be close by.
Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a crowd of people! Maybe
they're fellow players?

text_block_list.name: Adventurer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What are you two playing as?!
Those ears look pretty long...
Are you
elves? Or maybe werewolves, judging by
the tails?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nope! We're Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Adventurer B
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! Umamusume... You mean, like real Umamusume? In a game like this? This is gonna be wild!

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhhh, Umamusume! The legend was
true! Perhaps this is our
salvation sent from
above.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The... legend? Could you explain?

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
It has long been foretold—grave peril will
befall the land of Umanest.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
"Fantasy incarnate shall look down upon
this world from the heavens.
With innate,
thunderous power, she will deliver unto
the demon lord a
strike of destruction and
felicity alike."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Fantasy incarnate"... I suppose that could
refer to us real-world
Umamusume, though
I'm more concerned by the last bit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The demon lord?! You're sayin' there's a
big bad demon runnin'
around?

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The demon lord appeared in this
world but a few days prior
and has since
defeated many of our brave heroes. How
lost we are in
the face of this veritable
crisis.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Estupendo! Did you hear that, Grass?
There's no way we were sent
here by
accident!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This demon lord's gotta be the source of
our trouble! Ordinary folk
might not be
able to stop 'em, but we Umamusume can!
That's why we
were summoned here!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So, you think the demon lord is what
triggered the bug? And...
considering the
game's legend, we Umamusume hold the
key to
defeating it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure of it! All we gotta do is defeat the
demon lord and our
problem will be fixed!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right. Time for a journey full of
adventure, combat, and victory!
Let's
defeat the demon lord and save this world
while we're at it!
